description: This is a React component file written in TypeScript, defining the 'InputParametersTab' component for managing input parameters within an asset details page. It includes UI rendering, state management, API interactions, and user input handling related to input parameters.

methods.name: buildUomIndex
methods.description: Constructs a Map from UOM ID to UomMasterDto for quick lookup.

methods.name: buildProgIndex
methods.description: Constructs a Map from Reporting Program ID to ReportingProgramMasterDto for quick lookup.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the input parameters list and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form and opens the modal for creating a new input parameter.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form with existing data and opens the modal for editing an input parameter.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving (creating or updating) an input parameter, including validation and API calls.
